0022600037.text: The Bulls (1-8, 14th in the East) host the Atlanta Hawks (7-5, 1st in the Southeast, 4th in the East) with Chicago on a seven-game losing streak and 5.5 games behind for fourth in the Central. Chicago is missing Dailyn Swain, Norman Powell, and Tobe Awaka, all out, and Caleb Wilson is day-to-day with a hand injury and a game-time decision, while Atlanta is without Asa Newell, Henri Veesaar, Keshon Gilbert, and Mouhamed Gueye. The teams have not met yet this season, and the Bulls won all three meetings in 2025-26, most recently 126-123 in Atlanta on December 23, 2025.
